title: Center generators of the specified complex twisted graded Hecke algebra for diagonal (Z/ell Z)^(n-1), n>=3 and ell>=2
author: Wee Liang Gan; Matthew Highfield
source_title: Center of Twisted Graded Hecke Algebras for Homocyclic Groups
difficulty_reason: The proof embeds the deformation in a twisted Laurent crossed product and computes the image of a new multipartite central element through a cancellation indexed by nonadjacent subsets of a cyclic graph. Root-of-unity products and the exceptional cyclic endpoint cocycle factor control the generator images; a filtered-symbol argument then proves that these exhaust the center, beyond merely checking centrality of displayed elements.
source_version: Official SIGMA 10 (2014) article 098, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2014.098; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Read full Theorem1.7, Proposition1.4 embedding and the complete key calculation Lemma2.2 including the endpoint-order footnote. Work is over C; n>=3,ell>=2,zeta primitive ell-th root,parameters t in C^n, G consists of determinant-one diagonal ell-torsion matrices, and alpha and H are exactly Definition1.2 with the specified nearest-neighbor cocycle. PBW is published background independently accompanied by the explicit triangular embedding argument. The source provides the subset cancellation and central Laurent images, followed by standard filtered lifting of invariant generators. Corollary1.8 hypersurface relation and Morita/Sklyanin specialization are not selected or counted. No claim that this is the most general deformation when n>3,ell=2.

statement_scope: Full Theorem1.7 for exactly Definition1.2 and its specified cocycle: Z(H) is generated by x1^ell,...,xn^ell and the explicitly defined cyclic nonadjacent-subset element w. No full classification of all twisted graded Hecke deformations or separate hypersurface-presentation corollary selected.
source_boundary_note: Full original Theorem 1.7 center-generation result is retained with the exact complex twisted graded Hecke presentation, cocycle, nearest-neighbor parameters, explicit triangular embedding and complete new subset-cancellation Lemma 2.2, including its cyclic endpoint-order footnote. The hypotheses remain n>=3,ell>=2 and a primitive ell-th root; all n+1 generators are explicitly defined. The central Laurent images and original filtered-lifting closure are supplied. Prior PBW and standard invariant generators remain named background, accompanied by the author embedding argument. No hypersurface-relation corollary, Morita equivalence, Sklyanin specialization or most-general-deformation claim is selected.
